question: What consequence follows from not eating during the day?
premises: This leads to a future outcome.
The outcome is death related to age.
inference: By not eating during the day, one will go to death by age.
uncertainties: The exact sense of vayo-mṛtyuṃ (death by age or death of age) is contextually ambiguous.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to death by old age.
